description_en: This API is used to query the real-time cycle usage of an IoT card
description_zh: 该接口用于查询物联网卡的实时周期用量
name: GetCardLatestFlow

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card, or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/sim/card)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/sim/card)的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call was successful.

Other values indicate an error code. For more information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。

其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Data.description_en: The real-time cycle usage, with the data usage unit included
Data.description_zh: 实时周期用量，带流量单位

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
